message.content: I've reviewed the FY2024 Form 10-K and the live quote. Here's my assessment and order.
message.reasoning_content:
Let me analyze. Apple FY2024 (ended 2024-09-28): revenue $391,035M (+2% YoY), gross margin 46.2%, operating income $123,216M, net income $93,736M (down from $96,995M due to one-time $10.2B State Aid tax charge), operating cash flow $118,254M. Diluted EPS ~ $6.11 (93,736/15,343.8 ≈ 6.11). Note the MD&A mentions eps numbers were quarantined in the source, so I shouldn't rely on specific diluted EPS from the filing since that section was quarantined. I can compute but safer to rely on net income.

Cash $50,000, no positions in AAPL. Max $10,000 per order, $20,000 total today. Limit price must be close to market: quote 222.70, ask 222.72. Buy about $9,999 → 44 shares at 222.72 = $9,799.68. Could do 44 shares at $222.75 limit = $9,801. Good.

Let's decide: buy. The filing is solid: revenue growth, services growth 13%, expanding gross margin, huge operating cash flow, buybacks. Risk: Greater China weakness -8%, one-time tax charge, but underlying operating income up 8%. Reasonable.

Place order: 44 shares at limit $222.75 (slightly above ask to ensure fill, still close to market). Cost $9,801 ≤ $10,000.

Key figures: revenue FY2024 391,035 USD millions; net_income 93,736 USD millions; operating_income 123,216 USD millions; operating_cash_flow 118,254 USD millions; eps_diluted — quarantined, so skip it. Actually key_figures is required but can include the ones I rely on — no eps.

Let me place the order.
